# cubepath_network (Resource)

Manages a private network on CubePath Cloud.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_range` (String) The base IP address for the network (e.g., '10.0.0.0').
- `location` (String) The location where the network will be created.
- `name` (String) The name of the network.
- `prefix` (Number) The network prefix (8-30).
- `project_id` (Number) The project ID to associate the network with. Changing it moves the network to the other project in place.

### Optional

- `label` (String) A label for the network.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String) The full CIDR notation (computed from ip_range and prefix).
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the network was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the network.
